blocks.text: Exercise 7.3. The mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan found an infinite series that can be used to generate a numerical approximation of 1/π:

blocks.description: Ramanujan's infinite series for 1/π; each term grows the precision rapidly.

blocks.text: Write a function called estimate_pi that uses this formula to compute and return an estimate of π. It should use a while loop to compute terms of the summation until the last term is smaller than 1e-15 (which is Python notation for 10^{-15}). You can check the result by comparing it to math.pi.
